newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Tietmeyer says G-10 to closely monitor fx markets.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says G-10 to closely monitor fx markets.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said the Group of 10 (G-10) would continue to monitor foreign exchange markets closely, but did not make further comments on the recently strong dollar.

Speaking to reporters in his capacity as chairman of the G-10 central bank governors committee, Tietmeyer said the governors had been briefed about the situation in the gold and foreign exchange markets, but declined to specify their discussions.
Referring to exchange markets, he said: "We will monitor further developments on foreign exchange markets very, very closely."
Tietmeyer also said the governors had exchanged views on the situation in Asia and specifically Thailand, but did not indicate if they were concerned about the flotation of the baht.
Asked if the G-10 was concerned about Thailand, Tietmeyer said: "We have to monitor problems around the world."
